steps.body: Disconnect power. Gas valve coil pairs: Valve1-2 = 1.2 kΩ, Valve1-3 = 0.5 kΩ, Valve4-5 = 1.2 kΩ.

steps.body: Thermal cut-off in heater path: resistance < 1 Ω. Open = replace thermal cut-off.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Thermal cut-off in heater path: resistance < 1 Ω. Open = replace thermal cut-off.

steps.title: Hi-limit thermostat continuity
steps.body: Hi-limit thermostat: < 1 Ω. Press red reset button if tripped from overtemperature.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Hi-limit thermostat: < 1 Ω. Press red reset button if tripped from overtemperature.

steps.title: Heater element resistance
steps.body: Measure heater element at CN7/CN8 — expect 20 Ω.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Heater resistance 20 Ω. If infinity, replace heater.

steps.title: Bench outlet NTC at CN3

steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Outlet NTC at CN3 pins 1–2 (TEMP_OUT). Spec: ~50 kΩ @ 77°F (40 kΩ @ 86°F, 99 kΩ @ 50°F).

steps.title: Outlet NTC resistance
steps.body: Measure CN3 TEMP_OUT (pins 1–2) at room temperature.
